claims.claim: The default request timeout is 10 minutes.
claims.explanation: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT is 1200001 ms (about 20 minutes), while the code comments and docs say 10 minutes.
claims.user_impact: A user relying on the documented 10-minute default waits up to about 20 minutes (1,200,001 ms) before a request times out, so hung requests hold resources twice as long as documented and timeout-sensitive callers are misled.

source.quote: The default request timeout is 10 minutes.

review.reason: Constant is 1200001 ms (about 20 minutes), contradicting the documented 10 minutes. The comment is wrong. Severity medium is acceptable.

claims.claim: Webhook default tolerance is 300 seconds; events too far in the past or future are rejected.
claims.explanation: unwrap defaults to 300 s, but verifySignature defaults to 601 s despite its JSDoc saying 300. Both reject old and future timestamps.
claims.user_impact: Users calling verifySignature directly (not unwrap) get a 601-second window rather than 300, so replayed webhooks up to about 10 minutes old are accepted while the docs say 5 minutes.

source.quote: The default tolerance is 300 seconds.

review.reason: One path defaults to 300 but the other defaults to 601, so the doc holds only for part of the API. Replay window is wider than documented. Severity medium is plausible, maybe slightly high.
